verdict.rationale: Cooley GO ships web-based document generators, so asking whether everything in the UI is also available through an API is a fair question. The evidence pack documents no public API at all, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404, so there is no evidence of API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
